description: This file defines interfaces for a timer system, including the ITimer and ITimerFactory classes, as well as the TimerType enum. It provides abstract methods for creating, canceling, and checking the status of timers, intended for implementation elsewhere.
external_methods: std::unique_ptr<ITimer> ITimerFactory::createTimer(const std::chrono::milliseconds&, const std::function<void()>&, TimerType) const

classes.name: ITimer
classes.description: Interface for timer objects, providing methods to cancel the timer and check if it is active.

classes.name: ITimerFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating ITimer instances, with a method to obtain the factory instance and create timers.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of the ITimerFactory.

methods.description: Creates a new timer with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.
